scope.title: Errors return an executable, permission-scoped repair action

decision.reason: Every AppErrorCode now carries a stable code + retryable + a bounded, permission-scoped nextAction limited to fixed verbs; no shell/raw-script fields are possible; UNKNOWN carries no action so the original error is surfaced to the user. The existing error-governance single-envelope check still passes.

recovery.envelope: reuses HostResponse + AppError; no second envelope/error type

residual.ui: The error->recovery mapping is provided; rendering the 'next step' control in the UI is renderer integration work.
residual.scope: No default/lock/approval change; no second envelope/error type.

independentVerification.detail: Tests assert total coverage over APP_ERROR_CODES, that only self-retry classes are retryable with action retry, that nextAction has no executable keys, and that UNKNOWN has no action; the existing error-governance check re-validates the single envelope. No separate second-agent verifier role was run.

acceptanceCriteria.note: Every AppErrorCode has a recovery entry (retryable + scope + optional action).
Only self-retry classes are retryable and their action is exactly { kind: 'retry' }; others are user-action-required and never 'retry'.
nextAction.kind is one of five fixed verbs; keys are only kind(+target); no command/script/shell/exec/argv fields.
UNKNOWN carries no action, so the original error must be surfaced to the user (no fabricated repair).
Reuses HostResponse + AppError; the error-governance check still PASSes (16 checks).
5 new + 39 governance tests pass, typecheck:web 0, scoped lint 0, harness validate/dry-run pass, comms 0, credential scan 0 hits, SHA256SUMS verifiable.

notMeasured: A separate second-agent independent verifier role.

landing.note: Pushed with the evidence commit in the same session; see the branch's PR.
